# Where other programs keep their models

These are the store layouts tenstag reads: where each program keeps its models, and how another program should
read them. tenstag's own documents (locations.md, listing.md and names.md) cite these rules by id.

They come from tensdataspecs, a separate set of notes on model stores and file formats that isn't public yet,
each checked against the program's own source code or documentation (listed under Sources in each file). This
is a copy of the documents tenstag uses, kept in step with it; please report problems here.
